Ability may be {{a|Thick Fat}} when battled in the [[Pokémon World Tournament]]. |epnum=EP158 |epname=A Goldenrod Opportunity |prevonum=241 |noevo=incap |current=[[Party|With Whitney]] |java1=[[Megumi Hayashibara]] }} '''Whitney's Miltank''' (Japanese: '''アカネのミルタンク''' ''Akane's Miltank'') is [[Whitney]]'s main {{OBP|Pokémon|species}} in the {{pkmn|games}}, {{pkmn|animation}}, and {{pkmn|manga}}. She also appears as a card in the [[Pokémon Trading Card Game|TCG]]. ==In animation== ===''Pokémon the Series''=== ===={{aniseries|GS}}==== Miltank (sometimes referred to as ''Milty'' by her Trainer) first appeared in ''[[EP158|A Goldenrod Opportunity]]''. Whitney sent her out during Ash's [[Gym]] {{pkmn|battle}}, having saved her as her last Pokémon when her {{p|Nidorina}} and {{p|Clefairy}} lost to {{AP|Cyndaquil}}, with the latter forfeiting. Cyndaquil tried its best to defeat Miltank but was taken out by a supereffective Rollout. Miltank's next opponent was {{AP|Totodile}}. Totodile used {{m|Water Gun}} on Miltank to get her wet. However, Water Gun had no effect on the Milk Cow Pokémon and Totodile was taken out by a stronger Rollout due to its effect. With two Pokémon taken out on Ash's side, {{AP|Pikachu}} was the last one. Pikachu used {{m|Thunderbolt}} on Miltank since Water Gun would have given him the upper hand. However, Miltank's consecutive spinning by using Rollout caused her to dry up quickly and the {{type|Electric}} move was ineffective. As a result, Miltank's Rollout made contact with Pikachu, taking him out and winning the match for Whitney. [[File:Whitney and Miltank.png|thumb|left|220px|Miltank and Whitney]] In ''[[EP159|A Dairy Tale Ending]]'', Whitney sent out Miltank to battle {{TRT}} after they raided her uncle [[Milton]]'s farm to get some food. Miltank managed to send them flying with Rollout. Afterwards, Miltank demonstrated her Rollout attack on a grassy field and showed it to the group. Her training got interrupted by Team Rocket's return with [[Team Rocket's mechas|a giant rolling barrel]] that snatched both Miltank and Pikachu. The barrel used its own Rollout attack as a clean getaway. Miltank and Pikachu were freed by Cyndaquil and Totodile using Tackle and Water Gun, respectively. After Team Rocket's defeat, Miltank was used in the rematch against Ash. Ash relied on a strategy during the rematch that was used earlier to defeat Team Rocket's giant barrel-shaped mecha. Cyndaquil was Miltank's first opponent. Cyndaquil was able to tire Miltank out. However, it was once again defeated by her supereffective Rollout. Her next opponent was Totodile. Totodile dug trenches using his Water Gun in order to divert Miltank's Rollout. Totodile, too, was beaten by Miltank. Pikachu was the last opponent for Miltank. Miltank headed towards Pikachu but hit the trenches instead as Pikachu was super fast. Pikachu headed for the trenches and Miltank was on top of him, causing Pikachu to toss Miltank in the air and defeat her with a {{m|Thunder Shock}}. Whitney admitted defeat since her Miltank lost and she is her toughest Pokémon. Miltank reappeared in a flashback in ''[[EP184|All That Glitters!]]'' when Ash was recalling the time about earning his badges when they were stolen by a trio of {{p|Murkrow}}. She reappeared in another one in ''[[EP255|Why? Wynaut!]]'' while Ash and the others were looking for the missing Badges. ===={{aniseries|DP}}==== Miltank made a cameo in {{an|Lyra}}'s fantasy alongside Whitney in ''[[DP147|Bagged Then Tagged!]]''. ===Personality and characteristics=== Miltank is a tough Pokémon, according to Whitney herself when she sent her out during the first match with Ash. This claim was proven to be true when Miltank single-handedly took out all three of Ash's Pokémon without suffering a scratch. ===Moves used=== {{anmov/h|normal||Whitney Miltank Rollout.png|Using Rollout}} {{anmov|rock|Rollout|EP158|A Goldenrod Opportunity}} {{anmov/f|normal}} ====GOTCHA!==== Whitney's Miltank briefly appeared in [[GOTCHA!]]. ==In the games== Miltank is Whitney's main Pokémon in the core series games. She appears in {{5v2|Gold|Silver|Crystal|HeartGold|SoulSilver}}, in both rounds of [[Pokémon Stadium 2]], and in the [[Pokémon World Tournament]] in {{2v2|Black|White|2}}. In [[Pokémon Masters EX]], during her [[sync pair story]], Whitney explains that she met Miltank at the [[Moomoo Farm]]. Miltank used {{m|Rollout}} on Whitney as soon as she saw her. Whitney believes that Miltank was looking for someone to take her away from the farm and was using Rollout to test people to see if they were the right {{pkmn|Trainer}} for her. in {{color2|000|Pokémon Masters EX}} |} ==In the manga== ===Ash & Pikachu=== [[File:Whitney Miltank AP.png|thumb|200px|Miltank in the Ash & Pikachu manga]] Whitney used Miltank as her final Pokémon during her Gym battle with Ash in ''[[SP02|The Beginning Of Good Luck?! Pokémon Fortune Telling]]''. Whitney's Miltank started off with an advantage due to her powerful Rollout attack, but when Ash switched from {{TP|Misty|Psyduck}} to {{AP|Pikachu}}, Pikachu hid in one of the craters caused by Miltank's rolling and was able to survive the attack and strike from below, defeating Miltank. ====Moves used==== {{anmov/h|normal||Whitney Miltank Rollout AP.png|Using Rollout}} {{anmov|rock|Rollout|SP02|The Beginning Of Good Luck?! Pokémon Fortune Telling}} {{anmov/f|normal}} ===Pokémon Adventures=== [[File:Mil Mil Adventures.png|thumb|220px|Miltank in [[Pokémon Adventures]]]] ====History==== ====={{MangaArc|Gold, Silver & Crystal}}===== Whitney's Miltank appears in Pokémon Adventures. She has the [[nickname]] '''Mil Mil''' (Japanese: '''ミルたん''' ''Miltan''). Mil Mil debuted in ''[[PS105|Smeargle Smudge]]'' as a cameo during {{adv|Gold}} and Whitney's [[Bicycle|bike]] race. She was ordered by Whitney to use Rollout on Gold so that Whitney could be ahead of Gold. In ''[[PS106|How Do You Do, Sudowoodo?]]'', Mil Mil was once again ordered to use the move but at two different targets, a {{p|Sudowoodo}} and {{p|Rhydon}} which were blocking the way. Mil Mil tried to defeat the Rhydon, but to no avail, and Whitney broke her arm after Rhydon kidnapped her. Mil Mil reappeared in ''[[PS143|Irked Igglybuff and Curmudgeonly Cleffa]]'', where she saved Whitney and everyone else from falling on the ice. Afterwards, she finishes up the battle with {{p|Suicune}} after Whitney's {{p|Cleffa}}, Fafa, and her {{p|Igglybuff}}, Buff Buff, manage to confuse it with {{m|Sweet Kiss}}. Despite the advantage Mil Mil had with the slippery floor and being Whitney's strongest Pokémon, Mil Mil was defeated and Suicune, which turned out to be an ice sculpture, was still standing. However, [[Pryce]]'s tips managed to pin it down. Mil Mil was used in the opening ceremony of the Pokémon League in ''[[PS156|Notorious Noctowl]]'' where she battled [[Misty's Starmie]] and lost after a quick succession of attacks from Starmie. ====={{MangaArc|HeartGold & SoulSilver}}===== Mil Mil appeared again in ''[[PS442|Out-Odding Oddish]]'', where Whitney was seen riding on her while traveling with Gold to compete in the [[Pokéathlon]]. ====Moves used==== {{anmov/h|Normal||Whitney Miltank {{#switch: {{#expr: {{#time: U}} mod 2}}|0=Heal Bell|1=DynamicPunch}} Adventures.png|Using {{#switch: {{#expr: {{#time: U}} mod 2}}|0=Heal Bell|1=Dynamic Punch}}|image2=Whitney Miltank {{#switch: {{#expr: {{#time: U}} mod 3}}|0=Rollout|1=Milk Drink|2=Stomp}} Adventures.png|caption2=Using {{#switch: {{#expr: {{#time: U}} mod 3}}|0=Rollout|1=Milk Drink|2=Stomp}}}} {{anmov|rock|Rollout|PS105|Smeargle Smudge}} {{anmov|normal|Stomp|PS143|Irked Igglybuff and Curmudgeonly Cleffa}} {{anmov|normal|Heal Bell|PS144|Savvy Swinub}} {{anmov|fighting|Dynamic Punch|PS144|Savvy Swinub}} {{anmov|normal|Milk Drink|PS169|The Last Battle III|rec=yes}} {{anmov/f|normal}} ===Pokémon Gold & Silver: The Golden Boys=== [[File:Whitney Miltank Golden Boys.png|thumb|220px|Miltank in Pokémon Gold & Silver: The Golden Boys]] Miltank first appears in ''[[GB08|For Pikachu's Sake!! The Search For The Missing Farfetch'd]]'' as a use of transportation. Miltank battles [[Gold's Bayleef]]. During the battle, when her Rollout crashes at Bayleef's {{m|Reflect}}, she accidentally causes a rock slide that almost hurts Cleffa. However, she was able to rescue Cleffa by using Rollout to get to Cleffa faster. Later, Whitney sends out Miltank to deal with a {{p|Sudowoodo|giant tree}} that was blocking the path to {{rt|36|Johto}}. However, her Tackle was proven ineffective. In ''[[GB13|A Promise Given to Miltank]]'', she battles [[Gold's Croconaw]] during their rematch. However, Miltank becomes very sick along with the other Miltank at the [[Moomoo Farm]] and the only way to cure Whitney's Miltank was to feed her several {{Berries}} before sundown. After Gold and Whitney find some Berries for Miltank, Miltank is fed the Berries and she starts to feel better. ====Moves used==== {{anmov/h|normal||Whitney Miltank {{#switch: {{#expr: {{#time: U}} mod 2}}|0=Rollout|1=Tackle}} Golden Boys.png|Using {{#switch: {{#expr: {{#time: U}} mod 2}}|0=Rollout|1=Tackle}}}} {{anmov|rock|Rollout|GB08|For Pikachu's Sake!! The Search For The Missing Farfetch'd}} {{anmov|normal|Tackle|GB10|A Huge Mysterious Tree}} {{anmov/f|normal}} ===Pokémon Pocket Monsters=== [[File:Whitney Miltank PM.png|thumb|200px|Miltank in Pokémon Pocket Monsters]] Whitney's Miltank appeared in ''[[PM084|Fierce Battle Between Clefairy and Clefable]]''. Her role was to make milk and deliver it to the customers. {{-}} ==In the TCG== Whitney's Miltank was featured in the TCG as one of [[Whitney]]'s Pokémon.
